Title: Workflow
Text: Project-level reconciliation is an agentic workflow:  1. Read the latest DepClosure snapshot. 2. Select the smallest remaining SCC first. 3. Inspect only source-grounded dependency rows inside the SCC. 4. Record a ruling using existing dependency schema actions. 5. Update deliverable-local dependency records only when evidence supports the change. 6. Run a new DepClosure scan. 7. Repeat until strict SCC count is 0.  Step-4 rulings draw on the shared cycle-driven resolution doctrine (the shared repo-root `docs/CYCLE_DRIVEN_RESOLUTION.md`): resolve each SCC by one of four recorded moves — decompose / invert / merge / cut. The retire/preserve rulings recorded below are the cut/keep subset; the residual six-node longer cycle (no remaining bidirectional pairs) may require *decompose* (split a too-coarse node such as `DEL-03-04`), *invert* (reverse a dependency behind a contract), or *merge* if no edge in it can be honestly reclassified as non-blocking. Cut and merge are human-gated.
